meta.purpose: The monetization gate. A product card gets an affiliate link only when this file says the account has approved one; until then the site publishes a plainly-labelled reference link with no tag.
meta.why: Publishing a link that carries a tracking ID is an assertion that the site is registered to that ID in an enrolled Associates account. Nothing in this repository can confirm that, and Amazon's Operating Agreement makes an improperly formatted or unattributable link the publisher's problem — §2 allows Amazon to cease commission income for a violation, and §5/§6 make disclosure and link-format failures material breaches. So the conservative default is: disclose, link plainly, and flip one field when the account owner confirms.
to_go_live: Confirm shopnow047c-20 is an active tracking ID on an enrolled account.
Add this site (karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil1) to the account's listed websites.
Generate a Special Link for each ASIN below and paste it into approved_special_link.
Publish, click one link, and confirm the click appears in the account's report before adding more.
Set site_registered: true and one_link_test_completed: true, then rebuild.
